messages:
Maya (docs): Draft of the relnotes ready for review. Main asks: 1) confirm SDK example param rename in v2, 2) add short migration checklist link, 3) include known issue blurb about streaming embeddings + search mismatch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499

Omar (eng-runtime): I'll look at the snippets. Heads up: in the new client we switched `input_text` -> `prompt_text` and `return_stream` -> `stream`. Need to show both forms briefly.

Priya (devex): Can do a compact code block showing before/after. Suggest we also show the Python and JS one-liners. Keeps the relnotes useful for quick scans.

Liam (platform): Found two broken links in migrations: `/migrations/quantize-old` and `/integrations/old-kms`. I'll submit PRs to redirect to `/guides/quantization` and the new KMS page.

Maya (docs): Great. For the known issue, make it actionable: ops should have a short triage step. Want one sentence + mitigation.

Omar (eng-runtime): Suggested blurb: "Known issue: embedding streams may produce partial vectors if the client interrupts the connection. Mitigation: verify vector length on ingest and fallback to the synchronous embedding endpoint for atomic results."

Tess (release): Add rollout times: canary Wed 08:00 PT, gradual ramp Thu 00:00 PT, hold window 3h. Also note SLA watch: p99 latency and error-rate.

Priya (devex): JS snippet proposal:

// legacy v1
const r = await client.generate({input_text: 'hi', model: 'kitefish'});

// v2 (preferred)
const r = await client.generate({prompt_text: 'hi', model_name: 'kitefish-v2', stream: true});

I'll also include a Python equivalent and a one-liner migration tip: "Replace `input_text` with `prompt_text` and `model` with `model_name`."

link-bot: Linkcheck report: 4 warnings (2 redirects, 2 missing anchors). Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-499--docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/runtime-update (checks: lint ok)

Liam (platform): PRs for redirects opened: #500 (quantization), #501 (kms). Both update TOC entries.

Maya (docs): I'll hold merge until the redirect PRs land and the linkcheck warnings are cleared. If both land in the next hour, I'll merge and tag the release notes for publish. Thanks all :sparkles:

Tess (release): Confirmed I'll be on watch during canary. Leaving a note in #release-watch.

Priya (devex): Merged snippet PR and added the quick migration checklist link. Also fixed a small punctuation nit.

Maya (docs): Merging now. Will monitor linkcheck and the relnotes preview. Ping me if any new doc regressions show up.
